name: Billing Price 1
definition: Specifies the billing price of a service.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency code in which the unit price and original charge price are expressed.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Price per item or unit used to calculate the charge expressed in the pricing currency.

Method.name: Method
Method.definition: Identifies how the charge was calculated. ||Usage: The absence of this code assumes that the charge is calculated as the product of (volume x unit price).

Rule.name: Rule
Rule.definition: Indicates that the charge calculation is based on a particular rule. The rule name is carried here and is defined by the trading partners.
